At Shiambelos

Photos from the tavern’s Google listing.

A view over the whole city

Shiambelos sits on Yialousas in Pano Polemidia, high above Limassol. From the terrace and the long window front the view reaches over the city to the harbour and the sea. Guests describe a family run Cypriot tavern with a cracking meze and kids welcome. The tavern also hosts celebrations: one visitor held a baby’s christening here and mentions the help with music and decorations, the baby changing area and the wheelchair friendly access. Google lists a fireplace, a kids’ menu, high chairs and a free car park.

Tuesday to Saturday from 18:30 to midnight, closed on Sundays and Mondays. Reservations recommended for dinner.
